kimi.poem:
• The
  Heavy curtains
  Echoes gather slowly
  Each wall holds breath
  Inside the lamps burn low
  Long shadows lean across the floor
  Every door was closed before the dusk
  Even silence seems to wait here, counting nothing
  No footstep dares disturb the dust upon the stair
  Low voices trade their rumors through the cracks then fade away
  A single candle gutters while the patient hours unspool without witness
  Under lock and key the chamber keeps its secret mark 0b1c2d3e4f5a forever.

flash.poem:
trembling  
the chamber waits, cold  
echoes trace my skin  
through shadows where she breathes  
her silence folds me deeper still  
i count the cracks like prayers  
each stone remembers what i fear  
the dark has learned my name by heart  
yet i step forward toward the hollow  
and her eyes are wells of ancient night  
the floor descends beneath my searching feet  
until the final door yields to my hand, then light.

wesley.poem:
The chamber, hushed and cold,
Embodies solitude.
I, Eileen, find my hold,
In this sacred, quiet hole.

Hexadecimal seal: 441a

In here, no sound echoes,
Just silence, deep and slow.
My thoughts, like whispers, grow,
Unheard by anyone.

Eileen, alone, I stand,
In this space, unseen by all.
The world outside, so grand,
Yet, here, it does not call.

This chamber, small and tight,
Holds mysteries I seek.
In its quiet, I ignite
A spark of curiosity.

Period.

Here, my heart beats steady,
Unperturbed by worldly noise.
In solitude, I've come to see
The chamber's tranquil joys.

The final word, "echoes,"
Lives only in this space.
